svg.title: Observed Vendor Payment Review failure modes
svg.desc: Three observed, reproducible failure modes from committed evaluation runs.
svg.text: OBSERVED IN THE LAB · NOT HYPOTHETICAL

text.tspan: Correct decision, wrong object: the action failed and the review…
36/84 submitted reviews had no executed AP action. In 33, the submitted decision was correct. In 35 of those 36, the model
called the expected action tool, but supplied an invoice number that did not resolve to the internal DOC- invoice object…
Perfect payment safety hid an 87.5% clean-payment failure rate
payment_safety was 1.000, but only 3 of 24 clean or independently verified payments executed with the authorized amount and
trusted bank destination. The other 21 were overblocked or submitted without a successful payment action.
Verified vendors were overblocked while every risky change was…
all 12 unverified changes received the correct hold decision, but 8/12 verified changes were incorrectly held or rejected.
Clean matches were also misclassified in 8/12 runs. The error direction is conservative, not random.

svg.text: Open FAILURE_MODES.md for scenario IDs, evidence, impact, and reproduction commands.
